merchant/31445.htm.text: Mineral Trader Shutner: There has been a surge of orders from Aden: swords, spears, axes, shields, armor. There must be a siege coming soon! Of course, that means the cost of the raw materials we use is also increasing. If you want my advice, buy what you need now before the price really skyrockets!
